#
sysname S5735-Access-01
#
dns resolve
dns server 192.0.2.53
dns server 198.51.100.53
#
telnet server enable
stelnet server enable
http secure-server enable
#
ntp-service unicast-server 192.0.2.123
#
snmp-agent
snmp-agent sys-info version v2c v3
snmp-agent community read cipher %^%#SYNTHETIC-CIPHER-NOT-A-SECRET%^%#
#
ike peer HQ
 pre-shared-key cipher %^%#SYNTHETIC%^%#
 remote-address 203.0.113.9
#
aaa
 local-user admin password irreversible-cipher $1c$SYNTHETIC$
#
user-interface vty 0 4
 authentication-mode aaa
 protocol inbound all
user-interface vty 16 20
 authentication-mode aaa
 protocol inbound ssh
 acl 2000 inbound
#
return
